narrative.overview: Parkly's Admin Portal shares the exact daylight warm-limestone (#F7F6F2), elevated white (#FFFFFF), Harbor Navy navigation rail (#0B1628), and Signal Crimson (#D90410 / #EF010C) token system as the Host Portal and Android app—extending it for dense multi-tab KYC queues, AI dispute arbitration cards, RBAC user tables, and Chennai GCC corridor mobility analytics.
keyCharacteristics: Split Operations & System sections inside a fixed 248px Harbor Navy sidebar collapsing into an Escape-dismissible drawer below 960px.
Monospaced tabular columns (JetBrains Mono) paired with Manrope typography bundled directly under /fonts/ to obey strict Nginx 'self' CSP rules.
Accessible Modal dialogs for rejection notes, RBAC role changes, and suspension audit reasons with zero blocking browser prompts.

rules.name: The Restrained Signal Rule
rules.body: Critical crimson badges and borders mark unresolved disputes and critical alerts cleanly; resolved items shift immediately to verified emerald.

dos: Do enforce WCAG AA contrast across badges, tables, and placeholders (#5A6678).
Do keep h1 -> h2 heading levels sequential across every route card.
donts: Don't render emojis or window.prompt/alert inside admin workflows.
Don't add border-left: 3px active link borders or unstyled dark chart tooltips.
